mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, standard_id, standard_name, id, transfer_id, material_inventory_id, classify_id, source_project_id, source_workshop_id, source_warehouse_id, transfer_type, quantity, remark, mete, weighted_average_price, price_excluding_VAT, bool_borrow, type, basic_class, specification, length, width, thickness, brand, heat_no_and_batch_no, color, amount, amount_excluding_vat, input_vat, invoice_type, material_is_whole, tax_rate, theory_thickness
mapper.select: select p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName from wms_transfer_detail wtd left join contract_project p on p.id = wtd.source_project_id left join wms_workshop mbf on wtd.source_workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wtd.source_warehouse_id where wtd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wtd.transfer_id = #{id}

select wtd.*, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, pm.name pmName, pa.name paName, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName from wms_transfer_detail wtd left join contract_project p on p.id = wtd.source_project_id left join wms_workshop mbf on wtd.source_workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wtd.source_warehouse_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wtd.classify_id left join plan_monomer pm on pm.id = wtd.source_monomer_id left join plan_area pa on pa.id = wtd.source_area_id where wtd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wtd.transfer_id = #{id}
